Description: Same as the Supabase Auth user id. References auth.users(id); deleted with the user (cascade).
Login email address. Must be unique.
Account type. Allowed: farmer, lgu_staff, admin.
Barangay of the user. Fixed to Caganganan for new accounts.
Sub-location (purok). Allowed: Purok Malinawon, Purok Malipayon, Purok San Francisco, Purok Anahaw, Purok Rose Mabuhay, Purok Liko Liko, Purok Awa-aw.
False means the account is disabled. New LGU staff accounts start disabled until approved.
Owner of the record. References profiles(id); the field is deleted with its farmer (cascade).
Name the farmer gave the field.
Purok where the field is. Allowed: Purok Malinawon, Purok Malipayon, Purok San Francisco, Purok Anahaw, Purok Rose Mabuhay, Purok Liko Liko, Purok Awa-aw.
Name of the person who maintains the field.
Field area in hectares. Recalculated when a boundary is saved.
Boundary of the field as a list of map points.
Current crop stage. Allowed: fallow, land_prep, planted, growing, harvested.
True once LGU staff approve the field. Only approved fields appear in public data. Set by the server, not by the app.
LGU staff member who approved the field. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Outcome of the LGU review while not approved. Allowed: pending, needs_correction, rejected.
LGU explanation for a rejection or correction request. Required for those outcomes.
Last change. Set by the server and used to stop approval of an out-of-date version.
Field the file belongs to. References rice_fields(id); deleted with the field.
Public URL of the file in storage.
Who uploaded it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Condition shown in a 360° panorama. Allowed: unplanted, planted, growth_status, ready_to_harvest.
Field that changed. References rice_fields(id); deleted with the field.
Who made the change. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
The observation the user gave for the change.
Field the note is about. References rice_fields(id); deleted with the field.
Who wrote it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
True means only the author can see it.
Field the report is about. References rice_fields(id); deleted with the field.
Farmer who sent it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Crop stage reported. Allowed: fallow, land_prep, planted, growing, harvested.
Condition of the field. Allowed: healthy, pest_affected, diseased, drought_stressed.
Optional photo, stored in Supabase Storage.
Allowed: submitted, reviewed (validated by the LGU).
LGU staff member who validated it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Field being planted. References rice_fields(id); deleted with the field.
Crop cycle observed. References crop_cycles(id); deleted with the cycle.
Who recorded it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Allowed: seedling, tillering, booting, heading, ripening.
Type of pest, when pest affected.
Recipient. References profiles(id); deleted with the user.
Whether the user has opened it.
In-app page the notification points to.
Purok it is addressed to. Empty means every farmer.
LGU staff member who sent it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Who did it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
Kind of record affected, for example field.
Who last changed it. References profiles(id); cleared if that user is deleted.
